units.source_text: 此诗句见白居易全集第三卷末《缚戎人》。

en.t: This line of verse appears at the end of volume three of the complete works of Bai Juyi, in “The Bound Barbarian.”

units.source_text: 被吐蕃掳去的汉人，在吐蕃娶妻生子，后因思乡心切，冒死逃归故国。

en.t: A Han Chinese man who had been carried off by Tibet married and had children there, but later, driven by intense homesickness, risked his life to flee back to his homeland.

units.source_text: 但唐朝边将视之为戎人，将其缚起来。

en.t: However, the Tang border commander regarded him as a barbarian and had him bound.
Bungo no Suke compared himself to this barbarian.
